items.name: CHIPS Act Letter of Intent award
items.claim: Coherent received a CHIPS Letter of Intent award for $50M, building on $20M previously provided through the Texas Semiconductor Innovation Fund, tied to modernization and expansion of its Sherman, TX manufacturing facility.
items.source_excerpt: to $50M in CHIPS Act funding, building on $20M previously provided through Texas Semiconductor Innovation Fund and the Sherman Economic Development Corporation. Groundbreaking ceremony in Sherman, TX celebrated the modernization and expansion of Coherent’s manufacturing facility

notes: Coherent's Q4 FY26 earnings exhibit discloses a $50M CHIPS Act Letter of Intent award tied to its Sherman, TX facility, already stored at data/edgar/docs/COHR.json. No separate backlog/RPO dollar figure found in the same exhibit.
